status: Declared before actual acceptance execution of the durable scene consumer
question: Can the same original RequestExpedition preserve accepted consent, terms, costs, actual nested encounter progress and observed consequences across real host-process replacement without granting a return, replaying intent or silently resetting a run?
beneficiary: The existing visible and downloadable authored scene gains explicit local saved continuity; this is not another isolated recovery benchmark or a new gameplay owner.
baseline: The previous Room keeps one ephemeral RequestExpedition. Browser refresh only reads it; process exit loses accepted choices. The existing PreparedExpedition Recovery journal does not already preserve this narrative owner.
ownership_and_claims: One authoritative actual RequestExpedition owns consent, dialogue, Rill, finite work, encounters and receipts. Journal replay reconstructs it by accepted exact commands; persisted HP, delivery or return fields cannot become authority.
All accepted commands, including conversations that change private permissions without changing public Snapshot fields, belong in the transcript.
Rejected-action feedback is transient. Durable sequence/revision counts accepted commands only; reopening restores the last accepted observation rather than claiming every refusal text was saved.

Durable body is exactly command, request_id, revision and run_id. Current-day run_id is checked before duplicate handling. A known request ID with the same content can return current saved facts without reapplying; changed content conflicts.

Explicit restart appends a new-day event, preserves prior accepted history, changes the current day identity and blocks old-day commands, including known old IDs. It is not an implicit overwrite or reset after an error.
Publication of an accepted receipt follows a completed local journal commit. Uncertain I/O blocks that owner until actual reopen; no UI may label uncertain writes saved.

This is trusted-local Linux process/file continuity. It does not establish power-loss durability, hostile tamper resistance, account ownership, a distributed service, Windows save behavior, Steam Cloud, Unity tooling or human adequacy.

actual_process_boundaries.setup: Actual successful survey, open and hear.
actual_process_boundaries.assertion: After fresh host resume, exact saved facts/text remain and offer is actually accepted. Public Snapshot equality alone cannot establish preservation of private consentRevision.
After fresh host resume, confirm is actually accepted with the same fresh terms and guide offer; no guide departure, delivery or return is inferred.
Resume preserves local-preparing guide state, reduced local work capacity, commitment receipt and unspent travel cost; departure is still pending.

actual_process_boundaries.setup: Actual guided departure and one accepted skill action, then terminate the owned host process.
actual_process_boundaries.assertion: Fresh host restores exact active encounter HP, resolve, position, beat and paid shifts. The next real skill advances precisely the next beat; reload never heals or replays the previous action.

actual_process_boundaries.setup: In a separate owned run, complete survey and accepted guided departure, then actually lose the delivery encounter.
actual_process_boundaries.assertion: Fresh host retains failed status, unchecked delivery/return and Rill unaccounted. Remaining local work may proceed at actual reduced capacity; reload cannot restore him or invent death.

actual_process_boundaries.setup: Actually finish the nested guided delivery after doing one local work shift before survey.
actual_process_boundaries.assertion: Fresh host retains delivered/observed return, spent daylight, real receipts and two of five crates carried. Three unfinished crates remain.

predeclared_safe_actions.interpretation: These are feasibility/setup policies through the actual fixed Lure/Trail owner, not human balance, optimal play or additional independent source observations. Retain unexpected outcomes rather than retuning them silently.

selected_negative_cases: Accepted request retry after later progress changes no persisted bytes, revision, costs or current state.
Stale revision, wrong current-day identity and injected state fields cannot change the saved scene.
After explicit new day, old queued intent and an old known request ID are refused before duplicate replay.
Creating over an existing run and resuming a missing or corrupt run refuse startup without overwriting saved bytes or exposing a fresh initial scene.
Only a selected real pre-commit I/O failure and accepted-but-unreceived receipt need targeted additional coverage; do not automatically repeat all previous Recovery fault matrices.

alternatives: Actual licensed Unity/Windows source-to-player execution outranks this fallback when Editor, activation, modules and execution really exist.
Appropriate author/player/device assessment is required for comprehension, preference or accessibility claims; agents and repeated software runs are not participants.
Reputation arithmetic remains a credible unresolved legacy alternative, but effects_for is empty and an actual new beneficiary/policy would be needed.
Full schedules, creation parsing, item/tool/unlock catalogs and quest/reputation integration remain separate unresolved obligations.
selection_and_limits.scope: A bounded production continuity dependency of one actual existing authored scene. No new fictional canon, historical RPG runtime, model score, universal journal framework or laboratory-maturity promotion is claimed.
selection_and_limits.evidence: Record actual process commands, exact accepted-state comparisons, semantic next-action permissions, saved-byte preservation and retained negatives. Updated packaging is support for the changed delivery closure, not a second effort unit.

scientific_influence: SCI-076: actual process/file observations support local continuity claims; participant methods support experience claims.
SCI-077: retain losses and incompatibility, avoid counting repeated cases as independent observations, and do not treat hashes or compilation as adequacy.
